The '''Galov sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Antoll Jellrek]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Galov sector included [[Romar]] and [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
